tracks.title: Tempa Lagi
tracks.subject: the youngest of five hammermen in a gong smithy in Wirun, Sukoharjo, forging a ninety-centimetre bronze gong ageng for a Solo dance school over three weeks of charcoal fire and hand hammers, under old Pak Darmo, who grips the red-hot disc in long tongs and keeps saying it will not sing yet, until the morning he strikes it once and sits down while the hum fills the shed
